# Does your unlimited wash plan actually make money?

> Car wash membership calculator for owners and managers. Enter your unlimited plan price, cost per wash and how often members wash to see net per member, break-even washes, heavy users who lose money, lifetime value, tunnel capacity and a price sensitivity table. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
